name: Blue Muffin Tarantula | 1g
description:
Blueberry meets baked goods. The indica genetics bring heavy body relaxation while the muffin-top sweetness keeps it from being one-note. Smells like a bakery that grows its own weed. Slow burn, clean finish.

* Liquid Diamond Infused: Injected with concentrate for amplified potency.
* Kief Crusted: Rolled in kief for an extra layer of flavor and THC.
